judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The worried-wife plea and the 'ankh' reward have Nox's plain, homely tone, but the closing speech runs backwards (reward and a 'dead are on the march' warning come before the reunion line). 'Brave Adventurer', the 'Necromancer's wicked deeds' line and a captive who says 'I'll stay right here' read like pieces stitched together, not one written scene.
